state_rule: Future transitions require validated domain evidence and operation policy; none is enabled by this design artifact.

required_sections.name: identity
required_sections.requirement: schema/record kind, event and cycle IDs, source record digest, model version; no mutable public eligibility boolean

required_sections.name: source
required_sections.requirement: Original decimal values, JD/MJD/offset zero point, scale and reference location, complete parameter-set/fit/covariance provenance, duration basis, validity bounds

required_sections.name: observer
required_sections.requirement: Site vector/datum/epoch with bounded error; ICRS target epoch and motion/parallax/radial-velocity assumptions and limits

required_sections.name: model
required_sections.requirement: Included/omitted correction inventory, sign conventions, source-compatible clock and geometric convention; inclusion audit preventing Einstein double counting

required_sections.name: data
required_sections.requirement: Kernel/leap/EOP hashes, versions, licences/source attribution, validity/interpolation rules and coverage for full solving and query brackets

required_sections.name: instants
required_sections.requirement: TAI two-part decimal JD per midpoint/ingress/egress, units and lossless precision; optional UTC labels with explicit representability

required_sections.name: conversion_evidence
required_sections.requirement: Solver/version, iterations, forward residual units, evaluated bracket, positive derivative lower bound and provenance, absolute forward and output bounds, evidence-domain binding

required_sections.name: uncertainty
required_sections.requirement: Source and transported covariance/standard uncertainty separately from absolute numerical/model bounds; null and reasons for unsupported/unknown distributions

required_sections.name: query
required_sections.requirement: Original coordinate, closed or half-open endpoints, conservative candidate enclosure proof, candidate IDs and final tri-state membership with retained excluded/indeterminate reasons

required_sections.name: observing_margins
required_sections.requirement: Resolve coordinate contacts first; SI-elapsed baselines on TAI; nonzero sigma padding requires known transported uncertainty and policy

required_sections.name: eligibility
required_sections.requirement: Derived per-operation status and reasons, never trusted from persisted true; range-valid evidence and source/model compatibility rechecked

required_sections.name: persistence
required_sections.requirement: Unknowns null, exact decimal or two-part fields, source+data+evidence digests, complete provenance round trip; legacy schema-v1 and unresolved schema-v2 never auto-promoted

error_budget_equation: arrival_bound <= (absolute_forward_bound + absolute_solver_residual)/positive_slope_lower + output_representation_bound; conditional on a common bracket containing the root and approximate solution
query_rule: Classify closed arrival-error interval [L,U] against exact query: closed [a,b] inside L>=a and U<=b, outside U<a or L>b; half-open [a,b) inside L>=a and U<b, outside U<a or L>=b; otherwise boundary_indeterminate. Empty [a,a) always outside.
query_scope: Nominal conversion interval only; not a probabilistic coverage interval or candidate-generation implementation.
candidate_enclosure: For a proven monotone forward map and bounded endpoint error, use outward rounded source-coordinate boundary enclosures, enumerate all possibly intersecting cycles, then final tri-state observer classification. Do not use an unproven fixed light-time pad.
uncertainty_rule: For F(t,q)=B, implicit local Jacobian dt/dB=1/F_t and dt/dq=-F_q/F_t; transport the full joint covariance J Sigma J^T with units, cross terms and linearization validity. Unknown contributing terms stay unknown. Bounds are separate from standard uncertainties.

scenarios.input: Source says BJD TDB but correction inventory is unknown
scenarios.required_outcome: unresolved: source_convention_unestablished

scenarios.input: Mission 38 maximum or 1 ms acceptance threshold supplied as absolute physical bound
scenarios.required_outcome: reject evidence-class substitution

scenarios.input: Unknown required bound or positive derivative certificate absent
scenarios.required_outcome: physical total remains null; no timing eligibility

scenarios.input: Standard deviation supplied as worst-case bound or RSS of absolute errors
scenarios.required_outcome: reject classification/aggregation

scenarios.input: Additional observer Einstein correction requested on top of site-aware dtdb
scenarios.required_outcome: reject until non-overlap or replacement derivation is supplied

scenarios.input: Source or target epoch/motion/distance evidence missing or outside validity
scenarios.required_outcome: unresolved; preserve missing fields and reasons

scenarios.input: Root not bracketed, derivative nonpositive/uncertified, or solver failed
scenarios.required_outcome: unresolved; no UTC scheduling use

scenarios.input: UTC observing range against barycentric source ephemeris
scenarios.required_outcome: prove enclosing candidate range, then classify resolved midpoint intervals

scenarios.input: Closed point query with exact zero-width interval at boundary
scenarios.required_outcome: inside; no duplicates

scenarios.input: Half-open upper endpoint equals resolved exact midpoint
scenarios.required_outcome: outside

scenarios.input: Conversion interval straddles an inclusion boundary
scenarios.required_outcome: boundary_indeterminate; retain candidate/reason

scenarios.input: Query boundary uncertainty is nonzero or unsupported
scenarios.required_outcome: propagate enclosure or remain indeterminate; never pretend exact query

scenarios.input: Midpoint correction copied to contacts
scenarios.required_outcome: reject unless separately derived bound; otherwise resolve each contact

scenarios.input: Nonzero sigma padding with unknown transported variance
scenarios.required_outcome: reject padded/ranked operation, preserve nominal result separately

scenarios.input: Elapsed observing margins cross a leap second
scenarios.required_outcome: add SI seconds on TAI, preserve UTC leap label

scenarios.input: Datetime/ICS cannot encode leap instant or export loses meaningful precision
scenarios.required_outcome: explicit export rejection/precision status; no silent shift

scenarios.input: Stored observing_eligible=true, tampered digest, or mismatched data version
scenarios.required_outcome: revalidate or reject; persisted authority is not trusted

scenarios.input: Legacy schedule or unresolved schema-v2 preview imported
scenarios.required_outcome: retain identity; require source metadata and recomputation

scenarios.input: Batch includes valid, unresolved, indeterminate and out-of-domain events
scenarios.required_outcome: retain all denominators and exclusion reasons; no silent missing cycles

scenarios.input: Known conversion bound but unknown astrophysical/TTV uncertainty
scenarios.required_outcome: do not claim measured-transit accuracy or calibrated confidence

remaining_acceptance: Independent full intended-model references with quantified reference error
Continuous or conservatively bounded model/data/geometry domain with root and monotonicity proof
Runtime immutable resolved objects and compatibility adapters
Persistence and export provenance plus all consumer bypass tests
